description: This file defines the view class for the configuration page of the 'jjwg_Maps' module in the SuiteCRM application. It contains PHP code that renders an HTML form for editing various map and address-related configuration settings such as API keys, geocoding options, marker limits, cluster settings, and address type mappings.

classes.name: Jjwg_MapsViewConfig
classes.description: A view class responsible for rendering the configuration page for the jjwg_Maps module in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the HTML form and associated UI elements for configuring map settings, address type mappings, geocoding options, clustering, and other map-related configurations.
